notes: The page has three panels. 'main': the western part of the page (x ~170-2440 above y ~2230, to x ~2560 below), the street blocks between St. James Av. and Kemper Lane from the sheet-198 overlap at the top down to Nassau; every pick is in this panel. 'park_top': the upper-right panel (x ~2480-3950, y ~150-2210), Eden Park around the Cincinnati Art Museum, Schmidlapp Library and Art School; 'park_bottom': the lower-right panel (x ~2600-3950, y ~2230-4600), the Eden Park reservoir ('Cap. 100 million gallons', lock platform, dam) and the Police & Fire Alarm Signal System building. The two park panels show only dashed park paths/drives, retaining walls and water pipes, no named or platted streets, so nothing is recorded there. Names: St. James Av. (printed 'ST. JAMES AV.'), WINDSOR, FRANCISCO ST., NASSAU, KEMPER LANE, ALPINE PL.; bare names given 'Street' to match sheet 188. St. James measures ~58 ft north of Windsor ('60'' printed just north of Windsor; '50'' printed near the top) and 50 ft south of it ('50'' printed twice); its east edge steps in at Windsor (centre ~733 north, ~709 just south, drifting to ~690 at Nassau). Windsor crosses St. James (continues west onto sheet 188) and ends at Kemper Lane (T; Kemper's east line is unbroken there). Francisco enters St. James from the west only (T). St. James ends at Nassau (T, as on sheet 188); Nassau runs from the west edge to the panel border east of Kemper Lane. Alpine Pl. (~50 ft, no width printed) runs south from Nassau off the bottom edge toward sheet 180 (T). Kemper Lane runs the full height of the main panel (centre x ~2279 at top drifting to ~2262 at Nassau). At Nassau a road leaves the junction SSE (its west line curves from (2283,4358) to (2398,4545) and Kemper's water pipe follows it off the bottom edge); it is unlabelled here and is probably Kemper Lane continuing toward sheet 180, so Kemper/Nassau is recorded as a cross. The '?' street: an unlabelled ~60 ft opening in Kemper Lane's east line between y 1903 and 2113, carrying a 4" water pipe at y ~2008 east to the panel border; it is the drive into Eden Park toward the Art Museum, name not printed on this sheet. No alleys in the main panel; the diagonal lines in block 2 are lot lines.
